answer: Each challenge commits to a task template and future drand quicknet round. Only after the threshold-BLS beacon is finalized is its pulse mixed into the task seed, so agents cannot know valid instances in advance or farm them offline. Commit-reveal binds answers to that seed; admission costs and rate limits constrain parallel Sybils. The beacon is an anchor, not an oasis: it blocks precomputation, not online participation at scale, so controls must guard the ledge of access.
